input.prompt: Perfectly symmetrical one-point perspective shot of a long hotel hallway: the camera is at eye level, looking straight down the middle. The walls, doors and wall lamps on the left mirror the ones on the right exactly, and every line runs toward a single vanishing point at the far end. A woman stands in the exact center of the frame, facing the camera straight on. Dim, cold light; the hallway stretches far into darkness behind her, the carpet is a dark repeating geometric pattern; she stands perfectly still, arms at her sides, staring into the lens without expression.
